name: HighsSplitDeque
brief:
Chase-Lev work-stealing deque with split point optimization

Lock-free concurrent deque enabling efficient task-parallel execution.

algorithms.name:
ABA-Safe Sleeper Stack:
  Lock-free stack for sleeping workers with ABA prevention:
algorithms.math:
sleeperStack: 64-bit = (ABA_tag << 20) | worker_id
        Push/pop via CAS with incrementing tag
  Avoids ABA problem in wait-free wake protocol.

**Memory Layout (Cache-Aligned):**
- OwnerData (64B): head, split copy, workers, RNG
- splitRequest (64B): Flag for thieves requesting more work
- StealerData (64B): semaphore, injectedTask, ts atomic
- WorkerBunkData (64B): nextSleeper for sleep stack
- taskArray: 8192 task slots

**WorkerBunk:**
- Global sleep/wake coordination across workers
- Lock-free sleeper stack with ABA-safe CAS
- publishWork(): Wake sleepers when work available

**Pop Status:**
- kEmpty: No tasks
- kStolen: Task was stolen, need sync
- kWork: Task available for execution
- kOverflown: Queue full, task executed inline

see: parallel/HighsTaskExecutor.h for executor using this deque
